Name: FuksiPallero
Explanation: Print numbers 1 to 100 on separate rows so that numbers divisible by 4 are replaced with the word 'Fuksi', numbers divisible by 7 are replaced with 'Pallero' and numbers divisible with both 4 and 7 are replaced with 'FuksiPallero'.
ExampleSolution: [print('Fuksi'[5*(i%4):]+'Pallero'[7*(i%7):] or i) for i in range(1,101)]

Name: Examweek
Explanation:
Input csv of strings.
Print unique values listed in input. with values being sorted reverse sorted alphapetically and the list sorted alphapetically
ExampleSolution:
items = input().split(',')
reversedItems = []
for item in items:
	reversedItems.append(''.join(sorted(item, reverse=True)))
unique_items = sorted(set(reversedItems))
for unique in unique_items:
	print(unique)
